sessions.founder_intent: Make the Council system more alive through a local operational console.
sessions.interim_authority_basis: Interim Authority Instrument; Founder direction of 2026-09-04

assignments.deliverable: Build and verify a read-only local Council Console backed by canonical Council state.
assignments.output: Implemented Council Console with active, Founder-review, blocked, and total session signals; validated seven Council Kernel tests and local CLI rendering.

dissent.text: No model provider or autonomous worker was invoked; the console is a local read model only.

sessions.recommendation: Use the local Console as the operating surface; keep state changes explicit through Kernel commands and add provider execution only through a separately approved adapter.
